本地产品清单不是有效的 JSON。请修正格式后刷新。: The local project list is not valid JSON. Fix the file and refresh.
上次启动任务已结束，请查看实际服务状态或启动日志。: The previous launch ended. Check the service status or launch log.
已有检测正在进行，请稍候: A scan is already in progress. Try again shortly.
上一次检测仍在完成，请稍后再检测: The previous scan is finishing. Try again shortly.
启动配置已变化，请重新查看并确认启动命令。: The launch configuration changed. Review and confirm the command again.
请选择可访问的本机文件夹，最多 16 个。: Choose up to 16 accessible local folders.
已保存扫描位置；点击检测同步发现产品。: Scan folders saved. Click Scan & Sync to discover projects.
products 必须为数组: The products field must be an array.
产品 id 必须唯一，且仅含小写字母、数字和短横线: Project IDs must be unique and use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
启动命令必须是非空字符串数组: The launch command must be a nonempty array of strings.
依赖清单必须是路径数组: Dependencies must be an array of paths.
进程归属规则格式无效: The process ownership rule is invalid.
端口策略须声明有效的环境变量名: The port strategy must specify a valid environment variable name.
依赖检查命令格式无效: The dependency check command is invalid.
没有可撤销的同步: There is no sync to undo.
清单在同步后已发生其他修改，未自动覆盖；可从备份目录恢复。: The project list changed after the sync. Wake kept those changes. You can restore from the backup folder.
已恢复同步前的服务清单；产品文件和运行进程未改动。: Restored the previous project list. Project files and running processes were left intact.
{name} 的新配置无法安全识别，已跳过自动更新。: Wake could not verify the new configuration for {name} and skipped the update.
检测期间清单被其他操作修改，本次未覆盖；请再检测一次。: The project list changed during the scan. Wake kept those changes. Run the scan again.
打开地址必须是该产品登记的本机端口: The address must use a registered local port for this project.
无法读取本机进程，不能可靠判断服务状态: Could not read local processes to verify service status.
进程归属与本机访问检查通过: Process ownership and local access checks passed.
已确认产品进程，但 HTTP 检查暂未通过；请稍后刷新或查看日志。: The project process is running, but its HTTP check has not passed. Refresh in a moment or check the launch log.
唤醒时会自动使用空闲端口。: Wake will use a free port at launch.
已检测到该产品进程，正在等待登记端口就绪；可刷新状态或查看启动日志。: The project process is running and waiting for its configured port. Refresh status or check the launch log.
缺少启动所需的文件或依赖。: Required launch files or dependencies are missing.
现有系统后台任务未能启动（退出码 {code}）；请检查原任务的日志目录权限和启: The background job failed to start (exit code: {code}). Check its log folder permissions and launch settings.
启动入口与本地依赖文件已存在；启动后检查实际就绪状态。: The launch entry and local dependencies are present. Wake checks readiness after launch.
可先唤醒 Docker，再检查已有镜像并启动；尚未验证容器部署是否完整。: Wake can open Docker and check for local images before starting the project. Container readiness has not been verified.
当前使用 {active}，默认端口为 {preferred}。打开按钮会跟随当: Using port {active} instead of {preferred}. Open uses the current address.
唤醒时自动避让占用及固定配置。: Wake avoids occupied and reserved ports at launch.
下次唤醒预计使用 {port}，启动前会再次确认端口是否空闲。: Next launch is expected to use port {port}. Wake will check it again before starting.
服务已运行，登录入口尚未生成；请稍后重试打开。: The service is running, but its sign-in link has not been created. Try opening it again shortly.
服务已运行，未找到当前登录入口；请查看原产品启动日志。: The service is running, but its current sign-in link was not found. Check the project's own launch log.
服务已运行，但登录入口尚未就绪或已过期；请稍后重试。: The service is running, but its sign-in link is unavailable or expired. Try again shortly.
服务已就绪，但系统未能打开入口。: The service is ready, but macOS could not open it.
系统后台任务尚未注册，加载失败；请查看启动日志。: The background job could not be registered. Check the launch log.
系统未能唤醒后台任务；可查看原产品的 LaunchAgent。: macOS could not start the background job. Check the project's LaunchAgent.
正在唤醒 Docker 并检查已有镜像…: Opening Docker and checking for local images…
Docker 尚未就绪；请完成 Docker 应用内的首次配置后重试。: Docker is not ready. Complete its setup and try again.
容器启动未完成；可能缺少已有镜像或存在端口冲突。请查看启动日志。: The containers did not start. Check the launch log for missing images or port conflicts.
系统未能打开已登记的应用。: macOS could not open the registered app.
启动请求已发送，正在检查进程归属与服务响应…: Launch requested. Checking process ownership and service response…
启动进程已退出；请查看该产品的启动日志。: The launch process exited. Check the project's launch log.
等待服务就绪超时；后台可能仍在启动，请刷新检查。: The service did not become ready in time. It may still be starting. Refresh to check.
操作未完成；请检查产品依赖与本机权限。: The operation did not finish. Check the project's dependencies and local permissions.
另一个产品正在使用同一端口启动，请等待后再试: Another project is starting on the same port. Wait a moment and try again.
没有可用的备用端口，请释放端口后重试。: No alternate port is available. Free a port and try again.
已打开本地产品清单；保存后点击重新检测。: Opened the local project list. Save your changes, then refresh.
尚无本工作台产生的启动日志: Wake has not created a launch log for this project yet.
仅能停止由唤醒启动、且进程身份核验通过的服务: Wake can only stop services it started whose process identity it can verify.
已发送停止请求；将继续检测实际状态: Stop requested. Wake will check the service status.
首次打开此产品，请先在详情中审查并确认入口。: Review and confirm the entry in project details before opening it for the first time.
服务尚未就绪，请先唤醒: The service is not ready. Start it first.
已检测到该产品的进程，请先检查现有实例是否就绪。: A process for this project is already running. Check whether it is ready.
首次启动或启动配置变化，请先在详情中审查并确认命令。: Review and confirm the command in project details before the first start or after a launch configuration change.
无法开始本次启动，请重试。: Could not start this project. Try again.
正在唤醒，就绪后自动打开: Starting. The project will open when ready.
正在唤醒，就绪后更新状态: Starting. Status will update when ready.
读取部署目录需要文件夹访问权限。请在系统设置的「隐私与安全性 → 文件与文件夹」: Wake needs permission to read the project folder. Check Wake under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders, then scan again.
操作未完成，请检查部署配置或查看本机日志。: The operation did not finish. Check the deployment settings or the local log.
检测到 package.json 的启动脚本，但无法可靠识别本机端口；已保留目录: Wake found a launch script in package.json but could not identify its local port. You can inspect the folder from its card.
源文件仍包含 Vite / React 默认计数器页面，未作为完整产品自动启用。: The source still contains the default Vite / React counter page. Wake did not enable launch controls for it.
检测到服务入口，尚未可靠识别网页端口；不会自动执行。: Wake found a launch entry but could not verify a web port. It will not run the entry automatically.
未可靠识别 Compose 的网页发布端口；不会把数据库、队列或不确定的端口当作: Wake could not identify a published web port in Compose. It will not open database, queue, or ambiguous ports as web pages.
已发现启动脚本，未可靠识别对应服务端口；保留卡片供检查，不自动执行。: Wake found a launch script but could not verify its service port. The card is available for inspection.
产品清单未声明可核验的服务端口或应用入口。: The manifest does not declare a verifiable port or app entry.
已检测到新的服务启动入口；依赖与实际就绪状态会继续单独核验。: Wake found a new launch entry. Dependencies and readiness are checked separately.
扫描位置不可用，未据此删除清单：{folder}: Scan folder unavailable. Existing entries were kept: {folder}
无法读取目录，已保留相关清单：{folder}: Could not read a folder. Related entries were kept: {folder}
达到本次扫描上限，已有服务已保留；可缩小扫描范围后重试。: The scan reached its limit. Existing projects were kept. Try selecting a smaller folder.
部署目录或自动发现的启动入口已删除: The project folder or discovered launch entry was removed.
{name} 的目录已移除，但服务仍在运行；卡片暂时保留。: The folder for {name} was removed, but the service is still running. Its card was kept.
